instrument_name.description: Human-readable name of the instrument, or "" when the file contains none.

instrument_start_line.description: First line of the instrument itself; 0 when there is none.

instrument_end_line.description: Last line of the instrument itself; 0 when there is none.

continues_from.description: Name of the sibling file whose text this file continues, or "".

ends_mid_document.description: True when this file breaks off mid-document rather than ending properly.

provisions.description: Every substantive provision of the instrument, in document order.

name.description: Short name including the provision's number, e.g. "8. Notices".

text.description: The provision verbatim from those lines, with OCR damage repaired.

repairs.description: One sentence on what was repaired, or "" if nothing was.

note.description: One or two sentences: what the document is and what fixed the boundaries, or why there is no instrument.
